No rebalancing; before tax and exit loads; NAV expenses already reflected.
limits: Present-day fund universe: closed or merged funds may be absent (survivorship bias).
Present-day scheme names and categories; no point-in-time classifications.
Overlapping three-year outcomes are not independent observations.
No historical TER/AUM inputs; no claim of out-of-sample strategy validation.
This is a lump-sum selection comparison, not a SIP return calculation.
